## Problem and change

Describe the use case, what changes and why it belongs in the shared toolkit.
Link any related issue.

## Validation

List commands and representative tasks actually run, with results. State anything
that could not be checked. There is no CI/CD pipeline; run checks locally.

## Compatibility and safety

Describe changed agent behavior, consumer update requirements and any security or
third-party licensing implications.

- [ ] I ran the relevant local checks described in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Examples and logs contain no credentials, private data or proprietary material.
- [ ] New references resolve and skill metadata matches its directory.
